Metadata.Name: Mario 64
Metadata.Author: Mario 64 in Sonic 3 contributors
Metadata.Description: Adds Mario from Super Mario 64 as an extra playable character slot (select him in Data Select, after Knuckles). 2D controls with Mario's moveset: triple jump, backflip, long jump, wall kick, dive and ground pound.

Options.0: Only in Mario's Data Select slot
Options.1: Also in Act Select & Time Attack
